title: Memory-aware loading of local models on the shared Ollama runtime
description: Chat, embedding and reranker models share one Ollama container capped at OLLAMA_MEMORY_LIMIT (12 GiB by default) with OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=3 and swap disabled. Ollama does not schedule against the container's memory limit, and the app does not check what is resident, so a combination the UI offers can exceed the limit: Phase 0 measured IFM K2 Horizon 7B plus Qwen3 Embedding 8B swapping 7.7 GiB, or being OOM-killed with swap off. The kill fails the in-flight answer and any running local jobs. Reported by the whole-branch review of feat/rag-context (finding 6). On 2026-10-09 the user chose to document the limit in the README and track a fix here, without a Settings note.
acceptance_criteria: Given a resident 7B chat model and a paper indexed with Qwen3 Embedding 8B, when a local question needs the embedder, then the runtime is not OOM-killed: idle resident models are unloaded first, or the request waits or falls back to keyword search with a plain note.
Given a local model in use by a running generation, embedding or rerank, when another model must load, then the busy model is never unloaded.
Given models that fit together under the limit, when they serve one question, then they stay resident and no extra reload happens.
Given OLLAMA_MEMORY_LIMIT is raised, when the same combination runs, then no unloading is needed.
test_cases: Unit tests of the fit check against /api/ps sizes, catalog sizes and the configured limit.
Integration tests with the Ollama fixture: idle unload, busy model kept, keyword fallback with note.
Opt-in live check: IFM 7B with Qwen3 Embedding 8B under 12 GiB, with zero OOM events.
verification: Planned on 2026-10-09; the limit is documented in the README. Evidence: Phase 0 S1 co-residency measurements in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-rag-context-design.md.
